title: Character Bible
description: Character consistency protocol. Fixed anchors must never be silently edited across scenes; changes require a version bump. See docs/character-consistency.md.

anchors.description: Everything here is FROZEN. Reuse verbatim in every scene featuring this character.

identity.description: One-line identity anchor, e.g. 'mature private detective'.

appearance_en.description: Hair, eyes, face, build — concrete visual features only.

signature_props_en.description: Identity props that make the character recognizable (watch, sword, case file...).

expression_range_en.description: Allowed expression vocabulary for this character.

forbidden_en.description: Never-appear items for this character (e.g. smiling brightly, casual hoodie).

consistency_rules.description: Project-specific rules, e.g. 'same seed + same anchor block until first 40% of scene list is generated'.
